bear_assumptions: Full-year adjusted EPS reaches only the USD 18.10 low end of guidance and receives a 14x multiple as reimbursement, cash-conversion, acquisition, leverage and multiple-compression risks dominate Q2 growth.
base_assumptions: Full-year adjusted EPS reaches the USD 18.325 guidance midpoint and receives a 17x multiple as recurring diagnostics, Central Labs growth and margin expansion offset leverage and acquisition risk.
bull_assumptions: Adjusted EPS reaches the USD 18.55 guidance high end and receives a 20x multiple as raised guidance, segment margin expansion, backlog conversion and debt reduction persist with stronger cash conversion.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark restores required confidence-adjusted expected return, base upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, and margin of safety while organic growth, segment margins, backlog conversion, cash flow and debt reduction remain supported; downgrade if reimbursement or volume weakens, margins reverse, backlog conversion deteriorates, free cash flow misses guidance, acquisitions impair returns, or leverage rises without commensurate earnings and cash generation.
